audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows disagreed across layers: every phases[N].side read 'Skill' while every win[N] read 'Irelia'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart reads Irelia on all seven rows and the content whys are specific, kit-grounded arguments for Irelia; the full-layer sides sit under the generic template whys. Two independent sources agree on Irelia, so the full layer is the copy that drifted.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side moved to Irelia, matching win[] and the packet, with every full-layer why rewritten to argue that verdict from Qiyana's actual cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike anywhere carried a cooldown; the packet's own defect list says there is no cooldown-sequencing advice in this matchup at all.
audit.why: Audacity is 11/10/9/8/7s, Terrashape a flat 7s, Supreme Display of Talent a flat 120s. Those three numbers are what 'wait for her combo' actually means, and none of them appeared.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, mid and phases[5].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors. breakdown.cooldowns claimed that once Audacity is spent 'she cannot reach you'. And both wants.you[1] and early describe Irelia's W as a 'parry' that lets you 'heal back the trade'.
audit.why: Terrashape is a second dash — a flat 7s, 1100 range, to terrain — so a spent Audacity does not strand her. Defiant Dance is a charged strike that takes reduced physical damage; it is not a parry and it does not heal. Bladesurge is the heal. The unstated interaction that matters: Irelia's E grounds both of her dashes, which is what turns a stun into a kill.
audit.corrected: Both dashes counted in breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d; the parry/heal claim replaced in early and wants.you[1]; grounding written into phases[2].why and breakdown.carry.
sources: champ-data/_kits/irelia.json (Q heal, W text, E grounding)

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d called Audacity a 'fifteen-second invitation' and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it.
audit.why: Audacity is 11s at rank 1 and 7s at rank 5. Fifteen seconds is a magnitude with no source and it would get a player killed by four seconds.

notes: Chart: all seven rows disagreed across layers (side Skill, win Irelia). I moved the full layer to Irelia because the packet levelChart and the content whys both say Irelia and the full-layer whys under those sides were generic template text. No win[N] edits were required — the content values were already correct — so each side edit resolves a disagreement rather than creating one. I did NOT touch phases[N].rating: the ratings read 5/10 early and 6/10 late, which sits oddly under an Irelia-favoured chart, but the difference between 5 and 6 is not something I can source from the kit, and diff EVEN / 5.5-10 against a 54.22% win rate over 782 games is genuinely a narrow edge. Flagging it rather than guessing. Two real mechanical errors corrected beyond the lint: Irelia's Defiant Dance was described as a 'parry' that heals (it is a charged strike with reduced physical damage taken; Bladesurge is the heal), and breakdown.cooldowns claimed a spent Audacity strands her, ignoring Terrashape on a flat 7 seconds. Not verified and therefore not asserted: whether Qiyana can Terrashape off the terrain created by Irelia's Vanguard's Edge wall, and which specific element grants the hard CC the kit flags on her Q.
